subject: Media Literacy
title: The Attention Economy
description: Learn The Attention Economy in one minute.

hook.text: You check your phone 96 times a day. Each glance is a chance for an advertiser to reach you.

buildup.text: In the attention economy, your focus is the product. Companies compete to capture and hold your attention.

discovery.text: Notifications, autoplay, infinite scroll — these are designed to keep you looking, so ads can keep showing.

twist.text: The average person sees 6,000 to 10,000 ads per day. You don't notice most, but they still affect you.

climax.text: Your attention has become one of the most valuable commodities on Earth. Guard it accordingly.

punchline.text: If you're not paying for it, your attention is the price.

quiz.question: What is the 'attention economy'?
options: A system where people pay for focus apps
A marketplace where companies compete to capture your attention for profit
A study of how attention spans are changing
